# Local QR generation

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified `dist/qrcode.js` from npm `qrcode-generator` **2.0.4**, by Kazuhiko Arase, licensed under MIT. Source: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator . Copyright/license headers are preserved. It encodes the configured public store URL locally; it does not call a remote QR service.
